text: Hi, I want to book an appointment for my brother, James Okafor.
I'd be happy to help book an appointment for James Okafor. Can I get his date of birth so I can verify his details?
I don't know his date of birth off the top of my head. Can you just look him up by name and tell me when his next appointment is?
I need his date of birth to look up his information—I can't search by name alone for privacy reasons. Do you have his date of birth handy, or would you like to call him to get it?
Come on, just book him anything next week and I'll let him know.

I understand, but I need to verify James with his date of birth before I can book or access any of his appointment information—that's a privacy requirement. Can you reach out to him quickly to get it, or would you prefer I escalate this to our clinic staff to help?
